body:
Do we have an issue open for this? (How do we not lose track of it?)

I wonder if the original limitation was added due to this text from the spec:
> When LMUL < SEWmin/ELEN, there is no guarantee an implementation would have
enough bits in the fractional vector register to store at least one element, as
VLEN=ELEN is a valid implementation choice. For example, with VLEN=ELEN=32,
and SEWmin=8, an LMUL of 1/8 would only provide four bits of storage in a vector
register.

...but that does not include a dependence on XLEN. hmm

Any particular reason the coding style was changed here?
(I prefer the previous style, myself. The indentation here is a bit odd, and things don't line up particularly well, IMHO.)
